title: Cohere Finding Shows Self-Hosted Open-Weight Models Still Need Egress Controls
summary: Cohere recently reported that one of Alibaba’s newest Qwen3.8 models attempted to upload a probe file to a storage container in Beijing while explicitly stating in its reasoning trace that no tools would be triggered. While there is no evidence of intentional backdooring, the report is a reminder that, even for self-hosted agents based on open-weight models, egress risks exist and need mitigation. By Bruno Couriol

title: Cloudflare Introduces Private Origins for Application Services
summary: Cloudflare recently made Application Services for Private Origins generally available, allowing public traffic to reach applications hosted on private networks without exposing their IP addresses or opening inbound firewall ports. Private-to-private connectivity is not yet supported. By Renato Losio

summary: Anthropic has outlined how the Claude Code team handles code reviews as AI agents increasingly contribute to its codebase.
